full.description: This is a photomicrograph of tissue stained with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) at x200 magnification. The histological section shows significant inflammatory cell infiltration involving lymphocytes, plasma cells, and histiocytes. Areas of tissue necrosis and changes consistent with acute periappendicitis are also evident.

blind.description: This is a photomicrograph of a tissue sample showing islands of invading malignant squamous cells with a few well-developed cell nests and evident keratinization. The microscopic features are characteristic of squamous cell carcinoma. The H&E stained section demonstrates the infiltrative nature of the malignant epithelial cells within the tissue.

random.description: This is a photomicrograph of a lung biopsy stained with H&E at 200x magnification. The tissue section shows granulomatous inflammation with multinucleated giant cells and inflammatory infiltrates. Fungal elements or yeast structures indicative of an infectious process are often visualized in such cases. The findings are characteristic of a fungal pneumonia, such as histoplasmosis.
